result.analyst_notes: Mission-led and aspirational, opening with an environmental goal and framing Tesla as a clean-energy mission rather than a business. Mostly factual product description in third person, with absolute claims such as 'Tesla believes' and 'the future we want' in first-person plural. Employees, DEI and shareholders are essentially absent; customers and environment are addressed most.
